cues.text: You will hear a conversation between a student and a job advisor.
First, you have some time to look at questions 1 to 5.
So, is this the student job centre?
Well, actually, I'm looking for a job.
Do you have anything available at the moment?
I'm afraid this service is only available to full-time students.
I'm doing a degree in business studies.
Well, I've been at uni for four years, but I'm in the third year because I took last year off.
Well, let's just have a look at what positions are available at the moment.
There's a job working at the reception desk at the sports centre for three evenings a week.
That sounds like fun, but unfortunately I have evening lectures.
So that's not possible, I'm afraid.
Is there anything during the day?
There's a position for a cleaner at the childcare centre.
Right. But you'd need to be there at 6am.
That's far too early for me, I'm afraid.
I'd never make it that early in the morning.
Well, there was a position going in the computer lab for three days a week that might be OK.
No, it's in the library, not the lab.
I think it mostly involves putting the books back on the shelves.
It's for Wednesday and Friday evenings again.
No, I can't manage that because of the lectures.
Look, I'll just get a few details from you anyway, and then we can check through the list and see what comes up.
Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 6 to 10.
Now listen and answer questions 6 to 10.
We'll fill in the personal details on this application form first, if that's OK.
I'm in one of the halls of residence for postgraduate students.
I haven't been living there very long.
Do you have any other skills?
Typing languages, that sort of thing?
Right, I'll make a note of that.
Now, let's see what else is available.
What do you think of administrative work?
There's a position for an office assistant at the English Language Centre.
It's for three days a week, Monday, Friday and Saturday mornings.
I was hoping to have Saturdays free, but I need the work, so...
Can you tell me what the job involves?
It says here that you'll be required to deal with student inquiries and answer the phone.
I'm sure I can handle all that without a problem.
Well, would you like me to arrange an interview for you?
Oh, er, could we make it a bit later?
Unfortunately I've got something to do at ten.
Hope it works out for you, Anita.
And thanks for all your help.
